name: artroot-chat
description: ArtROOT Chat — a premium AI-powered social media platform. Connect • Create • Collaborate • Powered by AI.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
